notes.title: "Wild Mars" has been accepted to DevGAMM Awards 2025
notes.notes: [p][/p][h1][b]Hello Survivors,[/b][/h1][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Great news here!!! [/p][p align="start"][b]Wild Mars[/b], has been officially accepted to participate in the [b]DevGAMM Awards 2025![/b][/p][p align="start"]This is a first important milestone. DevGAMM is one of the most respected game development conferences in Europe.[/p][p align="start"]It's a great opportunity to get [b]Wild Mars[/b] noticed on a larger scale.[/p][p align="start"]Stay tuned for more updates. [/p][p align="start"]See you soon!![/p][p align="start"]Enrico - Art of Level Design[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]This event is a great opportunity for small teams to showcase their games and compete. Whether you're building your next project or have just launched your game, it's a great chance to get noticed![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]More information about the event can be found here -> [/p][p][url="https://devgamm.com/portugal2025/"]https://devgamm.com/portugal2025/[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p]
